minor.issue: Pydantic model uses `email: str` — consider tightening to EmailStr to prevent header-injection via Reply-To. Non-blocking; endpoint works correctly today.

action_items: No code changes required. SMTP integration is fully functional: emails actually send (verified direct smtplib login + full end-to-end via /api/contact returning email_sent:true and Mongo storing email_sent:true).
Optional hardening: change `email: str` -> `email: EmailStr` on ContactCreate to reject malformed input at 422 layer and protect Reply-To header from injection.
Optional UX: consider returning a 'delivery pending' status if send_email returns False so mobile UI can surface it (currently the API is correct; just an idea).
critical_code_review_comments: send_email() correctly wraps smtplib in try/except and never raises — /api/contact and /api/bookings can never 500 from mail failures. Verified.
SMTP_SSL on port 465 with ssl.create_default_context() matches the PHPMailer setup in the user's email.php (SMTPSecure=ssl, Port=465, SMTPAuth=true).
MIMEMultipart('alternative') attaches text/plain first then text/html — RFC-correct so clients pick HTML when available and fall back to plain text.
/api/contact records Reply-To = contact.email so the business can reply directly from their inbox — matches the site's email.php behavior.

/api/bookings correctly persists the booking to Mongo BEFORE attempting SMTP notification; send_email result is discarded, so mail failures cannot break the booking response contract (booking_number + pin_code).
